architectures.name: x86_64 System V ABI
architectures.description: The dominant ABI for 64-bit x86 on Unix-like systems. Uses 6 integer argument registers and a 128-byte red zone.

architectures.name: Windows x64 ABI
architectures.description: Windows 64-bit calling convention with 4 integer argument registers and 32-byte shadow space.

architectures.name: AArch64 AAPCS64
architectures.description: ARM 64-bit calling convention with 8 integer and 8 SIMD argument registers.

architectures.name: RISC-V RV64 ABI
architectures.description: RISC-V 64-bit calling convention with 8 argument registers and clean RISC design.

architectures.name: x86 (32-bit) System V ABI
architectures.description: Traditional 32-bit x86 calling convention with all arguments passed on the stack.

architectures.name: AArch32 AAPCS
architectures.description: ARM 32-bit calling convention with 4 integer argument registers.

architectures.name: PowerPC64 ELFv2 ABI
architectures.description: PowerPC 64-bit calling convention with 8 argument registers and TOC-based addressing.

architectures.name: MIPS N32 ABI
architectures.description: MIPS 32-bit pointers on 64-bit CPU with 4 argument registers.

architectures.name: AMDGPU ABI (Target Family)
architectures.description: LLVM amdgcn family — many GFX IPs (CDNA, RDNA, GCN). Shared kernel ABI; pick exact chip with -mcpu=gfx….

architectures.name: NVIDIA PTX ABI
architectures.description: NVIDIA PTX SIMT ABI: .param kernel args, 32-thread warps, and .global/.shared/.local address spaces.

architectures.name: SPIR-V ABI
architectures.description: SPIR-V standard portable intermediate representation with storage classes and execution models.

CPU.label: CPU Architectures
CPU.description: Traditional processor ABIs for function calling, register usage, and stack layout

GPU.label: GPU Architectures
GPU.description: Graphics processor ABIs for kernel arguments, memory hierarchy, and thread models

Future.label: Future Targets
Future.description: Upcoming architectures: WebAssembly, BPF, CHERI, ARM SVE/SME
